notes:
Account snapshot: mid-stage enterprise legaltech firm focused on RAG for document discovery and e-discovery workflows. Primary goal: replace brittle keyword search pipelines with hybrid embeddings + neural reranking to reduce review time and surface highest‑value docs earlier. Key constraints: must run inside customer VPC (private control plane), strict audit logging and retention for compliance (7 years preferred), and ability to place hot/cold shards across regions for residency.

Technical requirements/highlights:
- Corpus size: ~20-30M documents (current sample 23M); expect growth to 50M over 18 months. Index size estimate: ~420M tokens; vector index expected ~64-80GB for 5M doc slice (depending on vector size & quantization).
- Embeddings: prefer 1536-d / 2048-d open model vectors; open to lower-d quantized vectors if cost and latency gains are measurable.
- Reranking: BM25 candidate generation + neural cross-encoder reranker for top-100 candidates. P95 latency target for interactive search < 1s, optimistic target < 300-400ms for first-pass results.
- Throughput: peak 180 qps for internal e-discovery hunts; typical avg 30-50 qps overnight batch re-ranks.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost/query <$0.002 for typical queries (hybrid average), with an agreement to trade model size vs cost. Ask: Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + caching to hit targets.
- Deployment: VPC private deployment preferred (no public traffic to index nodes). Option to keep control plane hosted but customer requests private VPC peering and customer-managed KMS keys. On-prem option evaluated for highly regulated clients.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 baseline required, SSO (SAML) integration mandatory, detailed audit logs (search queries, result ids, user ids) retained 7 years, ability to export immutable logs for e-discovery holds. Data residency: US-only for primary corp data, EU for certain client matter buckets.

POC specifics and success metrics:
- POC scope: index 5M representative docs, run 1k benchmark queries (mix of short/long queries, Boolean legal queries), compare: baseline OpenSearch BM25 vs Redwood embeddings + reranker.
- Metrics: MRR@10 uplift, precision@5, median latency, cost per query. Target: >=20% uplift in precision@5 while keeping median latency <500ms and cost/query < $0.0025 during POC.
- Ops checks: verify KV cache efficacy on legal long-context queries, measure memory footprint on dedicated GPU serving nodes, confirm automatic fallback to smaller model if node capacity constrained.
